title: Predictable · adj.
subtitle: 「可預測的／意料中的／可預見的／不令人意外的」，究竟是哪一種 predictable？
description: 「可預測的／意料中的／可預見的／不令人意外的」，究竟是哪一種 predictable？

words.note: 使用者提供。expected 是 predictable 最核心的近義詞之一，表示某事符合原先預期，或因情況而被認為很可能發生。它比 predictable 更偏『人已經預期會發生』，不一定強調可由模式推算。
words.example: The expected increase in demand was included in the forecast.

exercises.original: The rise in costs was predictable and had already been included in the budget.
exercises.zh: 成本上升是意料中的，而且早已計入預算。

options.explanation: already been included in the budget shows the outcome had been actively anticipated beforehand.
表示根據現有資訊或因果關係可以合理預見，常見於 risk/consequence。 本題的決定性線索是 an outcome already anticipated in planning；這裡需要的是「已被預期／意料中」。因此 foreseeable 雖與 predictable 有重疊，但是否強調事前預期、合理可預見性、事後不驚訝、預測容易度、事先準備或固定套路並不最吻合。

強調事情發生後並不令人意外，重點是 reaction rather than prediction process。 本題的決定性線索是 an outcome already anticipated in planning；這裡需要的是「已被預期／意料中」。因此 unsurprising 雖與 predictable 有重疊，但是否強調事前預期、合理可預見性、事後不驚訝、預測容易度、事先準備或固定套路並不最吻合。
表示事前已想到，且常因此作準備。 本題的決定性線索是 an outcome already anticipated in planning；這裡需要的是「已被預期／意料中」。因此 anticipated 雖與 predictable 有重疊，但是否強調事前預期、合理可預見性、事後不驚訝、預測容易度、事先準備或固定套路並不最吻合。
直接表示由模式、信號或規律可輕易推算。 本題的決定性線索是 an outcome already anticipated in planning；這裡需要的是「已被預期／意料中」。因此 easy to predict 雖與 predictable 有重疊，但是否強調事前預期、合理可預見性、事後不驚訝、預測容易度、事先準備或固定套路並不最吻合。

只適合 story/plot/dialogue/structure 等因固定套路而變得 predictable。 本題的決定性線索是 an outcome already anticipated in planning；這裡需要的是「已被預期／意料中」。因此 formulaic 雖與 predictable 有重疊，但是否強調事前預期、合理可預見性、事後不驚訝、預測容易度、事先準備或固定套路並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 可預見的；可以合理預料的
words.note: 使用者提供。foreseeable 表示根據現有資訊、風險或因果關係，可以合理預見某事會發生。它與 predictable 非常接近，但常見於 risk, consequence, future development 等較正式語境。
words.example: The consequences were foreseeable given the warning signs.

exercises.original: The flooding was predictable because the river had already reached a critical level.
exercises.zh: 由於河水已達危險水位，水災是可以預見的。
exercises.upgrade: foreseeable · 可預見的；可以合理預料的

options.explanation: critical river level provides clear advance warning of a future consequence.

words.example: Given the circumstances, the result was unsurprising.

falseSynonyms.zh: expected 表示已被視為會發生；predictable 更強調能從模式、原因或跡象推算出來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The expected increase was included in the budget. The outcome was predictable from the data.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者非常接近；foreseeable 較常見於 risk/consequence，表示可以合理預見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The legal consequences were foreseeable. Her answer was predictable.

falseSynonyms.zh: unsurprising 強調結果發生後不令人驚訝；predictable 強調事前就可推測。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The result was unsurprising. The result was predictable from the trend.

falseSynonyms.zh: anticipated 常暗示有人事前想到並作準備；predictable 不要求真的有人提前準備。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The anticipated demand increase led to extra hiring. The demand increase was predictable.

falseSynonyms.zh: inevitable 表示無法避免、一定會發生；predictable 只表示可預測，完全不等於必然。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Some delay was predictable. Complete failure was not inevitable.

falseSynonyms.zh: certain 表示確定會發生；predictable 只表示可以作出可靠預測，仍可能有不確定性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The result is not certain. The broad trend is predictable.

falseSynonyms.zh: possible 只表示有可能；predictable 需要有模式、證據或合理預測基礎。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A delay is possible. The delay was predictable from the warning signs.

falseSynonyms.zh: predictable 是形容詞；prediction 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The outcome was predictable. The prediction proved accurate.
